## Bug Report

Thank you for helping us improve SimCPR PRO! Please provide as much detail as possible to help us identify and resolve the issue.

### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of the issue. For example, "The app does not connect to my Little Anne manikin after a Fast Test."

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Open SimCPR PRO on [device, e.g., iPad Air].
2. Connect [CPR device, e.g., SimCPR ChestPad].
3. Go to [screen, e.g., Test → Exam].
4. [Describe what happens, e.g., the results popup never appears].

### Expected Behavior
What should have happened instead?

### Actual Behavior
What actually happened? Include any message the app showed.

### Platform and Version
- **Operating System**: [e.g., iPadOS 27.1, Android 15]
- **Device**: [e.g., iPad Pro 11", Samsung Galaxy Tab S9]
- **SimCPR PRO Version**: [shown in the result / measurement log, e.g., 26.10.04]
- **CPR Device**: [SimCPR ChestPad / SimCPR WristBand / Prestan / Little Anne QCPR]
- **Account Type**: [Cloud account / Local only]

### Screenshots or Logs
If applicable, attach screenshots or a measurement log (CSV). You can drag and drop files here.
⚠️ Please remove student names, dates of birth and other personal data first.

### Additional Context
- Did it happen in Train, Fast Test, Exam, or while issuing a certificate?
- Does it happen every time, or only sometimes?

### Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this bug hasn't been reported.
- [ ] I have provided all relevant details above.
- [ ] I have removed personal or student data from screenshots and logs.
